summary.en: A stable path to scaling window-based vision transformers to three billion parameters and high-resolution inputs
summary.zh: 将窗口式视觉 Transformer 稳定扩展到 30 亿参数和高分辨率输入的方法

description.en:
Swin Transformer V2 addressed three obstacles that appeared when vision transformers were scaled up: unstable optimization, a mismatch between low-resolution pretraining and high-resolution downstream tasks, and heavy dependence on labeled images. It combined residual post-normalization with scaled cosine attention, introduced log-spaced continuous position bias for resolution transfer, and used SimMIM self-supervised pretraining.

The resulting system scaled to 3 billion parameters and images as large as 1536 x 1536, while reporting strong results on ImageNet-V2, COCO, ADE20K and Kinetics-400.
description.zh:
Swin Transformer V2 针对视觉 Transformer 扩大规模后出现的三个障碍：优化不稳定、低分辨率预训练与高分辨率下游任务之间的落差，以及对标注图像的高度依赖。它把残差后归一化与缩放余弦注意力结合起来，引入对数间隔的连续位置偏置来支持分辨率迁移，并采用 SimMIM 自监督预训练。

这套方法把模型扩展到 30 亿参数，并可处理最高 1536 x 1536 分辨率的图像，同时在 ImageNet-V2、COCO、ADE20K 和 Kinetics-400 上报告了强劲结果。

html.en: By 2021, hierarchical window-based transformers had made transformer backbones practical for mainstream vision tasks, but simply enlarging them exposed optimization and resolution-transfer problems. Swin Transformer V2 was designed to make the architecture scale in both parameter count and input resolution without demanding an impractical amount of labeled data.
html.zh: 到 2021 年，分层窗口式 Transformer 已让 Transformer 主干能够用于主流视觉任务，但直接扩大模型会暴露优化不稳定和分辨率迁移困难。Swin Transformer V2 的目标是在参数量与输入分辨率上同时扩展，并避免依赖难以承受的大规模标注数据。

html.en: Residual post-normalization and scaled cosine attention make very large Swin blocks easier to optimize. Log-spaced continuous position bias transfers spatial relationships from smaller pretraining windows to larger downstream windows, while SimMIM supplies self-supervised pretraining before task-specific adaptation.
html.zh: 残差后归一化与缩放余弦注意力让超大规模 Swin 模块更易于优化。对数间隔连续位置偏置把较小预训练窗口中的空间关系迁移到更大的下游窗口，SimMIM 则在任务适配前提供自监督预训练。

html.en: Experts generally treat Swin Transformer V2 as an important engineering and architectural refinement of the original Swin family rather than a wholly separate vision paradigm. Its lasting contribution is the coordinated treatment of optimization stability, position-bias transfer and self-supervised pretraining, which made billion-scale high-resolution vision experiments more reproducible through an openly released implementation.
html.zh: 专家通常把 Swin Transformer V2 视为原始 Swin 系列的重要工程与架构改进，而不是完全独立的视觉范式。它的长期贡献在于协同处理优化稳定性、位置偏置迁移和自监督预训练，并通过公开实现提高十亿参数级高分辨率视觉实验的可复现性。
